end.summary:
Matched everyday objects with cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone, and sphere.
Identified 8/8 everyday-object matches without help.
Recognised a 3D shape in different positions or sizes in 2/2 attempts.
Teach-back was not completed; the child requested real pictures or sketches during examples.
end.parentNote: Asha practised matching familiar objects to 3D shapes and explaining features such as square faces, a point with a circular base, and a curved surface. Ishita used the idea that a cylinder stays the same shape when standing or lying down, and no shape mix-up was recorded. Teach-back was not completed because much of the lesson focused on requests for clearer object drawings or pictures. At home, ask Ishita to name the shapes of a dice, box, party hat, ball, and battery and explain one feature of each.
